note: Links point to the providers' own pages or podcast directory pages. Audio is never copied or embedded; learners listen on the provider's site under its terms.

resources.title: 6 Minute English
resources.description: Two presenters chat about a topical question and explain six useful words or phrases. Each episode page has a full transcript and a vocabulary list, so it is ideal for intensive listening.

resources.title: The English We Speak
resources.description: One informal expression or piece of current slang per episode, acted out in a short dialogue. Good for natural, colloquial British English.

resources.title: Learning English from the News
resources.description: Presenters unpack the language of real news headlines on a current story. A bridge between learner materials and authentic news.

resources.title: Global News Podcast
resources.description: International news with reports and interviews from correspondents around the world. Expect fast, authentic speech and a wide variety of international accents.

resources.title: In Our Time
resources.description: A presenter and three academics discuss one idea, person or event in depth. Dense, fast academic discussion — excellent C2 practice for following arguments and interruptions.

resources.title: More or Less
resources.description: Checks the numbers behind news stories. Useful for the language of data, comparison and critical thinking — directly relevant to IELTS Writing Task 1 and argumentative essays.

resources.title: VOA Learning English Podcast
resources.frequency: Daily (check the page for current schedule)
resources.description: News and features read slowly with controlled vocabulary. A gentle way into American English news before moving to NPR.

resources.title: Short Wave
resources.description: Short science stories explained in a friendly conversational style. Many episodes have transcripts on the NPR site.

resources.title: Planet Money
resources.description: Economics told through stories, experiments and interviews. Lively, fast American English with lots of idiomatic language.

resources.title: TED-Ed: Lessons Worth Sharing
resources.description: Short animated lessons on a single question. Clear narration, interactive transcripts and subtitles make them ideal for note-taking practice.

resources.title: B2 listening lessons
resources.description: Graded recordings of meetings, talks and conversations with transcripts and interactive exercises from the British Council.

resources.title: C1 listening lessons
resources.description: Extended speech on abstract and complex topics — job interviews, lectures, talks and meetings — with exercises and transcripts.

resources.title: Audio zone
resources.description: Speakers from many countries talk about their lives and experiences. A good source of international accents at B2 and C1.

resources.title: Podcasts for professionals
resources.description: Workplace conversations and advice for professionals, with transcripts — useful for business vocabulary and meeting language.

resources.title: Conversations
resources.description: Long-form life-story interviews with remarkable people. Relaxed, natural Australian English and a huge range of topics.

resources.title: The Intelligence
resources.description: Daily analysis from Economist correspondents. Dense, idiomatic and fast. Some episodes or full versions need an Economist Podcasts+ subscription.

resources.title: Intelligence Squared
resources.description: Live debates and discussions with leading thinkers. Perfect for hearing how speakers build, challenge and concede arguments — the same skills as an opinion essay.

resources.title: Overheard at National Geographic
resources.description: Explorers, photographers and scientists tell the stories behind National Geographic assignments. Clear American English with vivid descriptive language.
